summary.text: One of the allied captains whom Hector heartened when the Trojans strove over the body of Patroclus — named only in the rally of Book 17 among the tribes that dwell round about Troy.

story.text: When the battle raged about the fallen son of Menoetius, Hector went to and fro in the armour of Achilles and spake winged words to each captain of the allies — Mesthles, Glaucus, Medon, Thersilochus, Asteropaeus, Deisenor, Hippothous, Phorcys, Chroraius, and Ennomus the augur — urging them to hold their ground for gifts and honour.
